title: Grade 7 Mathematics Term 1 Lesson Plan
text:
Grade 7 Mathematics Term 1 Lesson Plan
Grade 7
Mathematics
Term 1
Numbers
Place Value
1
Introduction to Place Value
35
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to identify place value up to 9999
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to read and write numbers in words
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving - when solving place value problems
Communication and Collaboration - during pair work activities
Accuracy
Neatness
Environmental conservation - using numbers in measuring rainfall
Learner's Book Chapter 1
Place value charts
Number cards
Whiteboard and markers
Real objects for counting (stones, bottles)
Introduction
5 min
Review previous learning: counting to 1000. Ask: 'What is the value of digit 5 in 350?'
Step 1: Whole-class activation
10 min
Teacher uses place value chart to show 4-digit numbers. Learners repeat place value names aloud.
Step 2: Guided practice
10 min
Learners work in pairs: one shows a 4-digit number on chart, other identifies place values. Teacher rotates to support.
Step 3: Independent application
5 min
Learners complete worksheet: identify place value of underlined digits in 5 given numbers.
Conclusion
5 min
Teacher reviews answers. Learners share one thing they learned. Preview next lesson: fractions.
Observation during guided practice and collection of independent worksheet for marking.
To be completed after the lesson: what worked well, what to adjust, and learners who need follow-up.
